summary.text: Armin Mizani is the Republican candidate for the Texas House of Representatives, District 98, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the March 3, 2026 Republican primary.
He is an attorney and small business owner who has served as mayor of Keller.

paragraphs.text: Armin Mizani's career experience includes working as an attorney and as the owner of a small business.
Mizani served on the Keller City Council and was elected Mayor of Keller in 2020.
Mizani ran for the Texas House once before, losing the March 6, 2018 Republican primary for District 98 to incumbent Giovanni Capriglione.
In 2026 he defeated Fred Tate and Zdenka Wilcox in the Republican primary for the open seat, receiving 53.1% of the vote, and faces Democrat Cate Brennan in the general election.
